title: Service for participation in working life in structurally changing regions through self-directed and demand-driven support
summary: Contacting longterm unemployed participants via on-site support to help them to start return to work (re-employment) or at least start a new vocational training course.

interventions.name:
Persons with chronic (mental) health problems according to ICF, who fulfill the insurance-related requirements for benefits for participation in working life: repeated phases of unemployment or long-term unemployment.

intervention: with the help of a peer, participants are visited in their own en

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion cirteria for Participants:

- longterm or repeated phases of unemployment and receipt of benefits after SGB II
- stressful contextual factors (partner's substance abuse) or benefits after SGB VIII or SGB XII
- physical or psychological impairments for example obesity, addiction or fear related disorders in combination with 
- limited mobility, also due to these conditions, but mainly due to lack of local public transport and the lack of opportunities for individual mobility,
- care responsibility for children or other relatives
- a (repeated) discontinuation of other services with a similar participation character
Exclusion criteria:
- acute addiction issues
- occupationally hindering contextual factors (e.g., illiteracy, lack of German language skills)
- no special assistance is needed or other vocational rehabilitation measures are suitable
- capacity for work < 3 hours in the general labor market
